entries.speaker: NARRATION
entries.copy: Smoke rose from a house they had left cold.

entries.speaker: ADULT_SIGRID
entries.copy: You hold the door. I take the pantry.

entries.speaker: ADULT_SOREN
entries.copy: Inside—I'm opening the door. Answer me.

entries.speaker: ADULT_TAMSIN_REEVE
entries.copy: Last keeper went alone. Never returned.

entries.speaker: ADULT_TAMSIN_REEVE
entries.copy: Mireback. The ward feeds its armor.

entries.speaker: ADULT_SIGRID
entries.copy: I turn it. Soren holds the ground. Tamsin guards the door.

entries.speaker: ADULT_TAMSIN_REEVE
entries.copy: That crack will feed the next one. Repair the northern chain.

entries.speaker: ADULT_SIGRID
entries.copy: At dawn, I choose the road. We go north.

entries.speaker: ADULT_SIGRID
entries.copy: We take the north road. We return by a road we can prove.

entries.speaker: ADULT_SIGRID
entries.copy: The ink is wrong. The cairns still agree.

entries.speaker: ADULT_SOREN
entries.copy: Hold. It had the first strike.

entries.speaker: ADULT_SIGRID
entries.copy: Every charge ends on firm ground. It's steering us.

entries.speaker: ADULT_SOREN
entries.copy: Six breaths on the brace. Move now.

entries.speaker: ADULT_SOREN
entries.copy: I saw a mark and raised a weapon. I was wrong.

entries.speaker: ADULT_SIGRID
entries.copy: The node is under that water. We descend before dark.

entries.speaker: ADULT_SIGRID
entries.copy: I choose the passage. You hold our way back.

entries.speaker: ADULT_SIGRID
entries.copy: Bright is not true. Check the current.

entries.speaker: ADULT_SOREN
entries.copy: West wall. Three steps. I have it.

entries.speaker: ADULT_HALVOR_KEST
entries.copy: The key for iron, medicine, and entry.

entries.speaker: ADULT_SOREN
entries.copy: Counterweight. Every second stroke lands twice.

entries.speaker: ADULT_SIGRID
entries.copy: Medicine. Gear. Map truth. Passage. We keep the key.

entries.speaker: ADULT_HALVOR_KEST
entries.copy: I ordered it. Winter light had a price.

entries.speaker: ADULT_HALVOR_KEST
entries.copy: Forge and granary. Contract the line!

entries.speaker: ADULT_SIGRID
entries.copy: Lower crews—uphill by the wet wall!

entries.speaker: ADULT_SOREN
entries.copy: I hold the wall. Sigrid keeps the road.

entries.speaker: ADULT_SIGRID
entries.copy: No fire. The draft runs to the granary.

entries.speaker: ADULT_SIGRID
entries.copy: I mark its feed. Soren closes it.

entries.speaker: ADULT_TAMSIN_REEVE
entries.copy: The North Garden—and the thing rooted beneath it.

entries.speaker: ADULT_SIGRID
entries.copy: These stitch holes never met that fold.

entries.speaker: ADULT_SIGRID
entries.copy: Your craft does not command my route—or my body.

entries.speaker: ADULT_SIGRID
entries.copy: I hear you. Follow the flags.

entries.speaker: ADULT_TAMSIN_REEVE
entries.copy: Crownroot was our keeper. I moved the road.

entries.speaker: NARRATION
entries.copy: Green summer opened beneath a winter sky.

entries.speaker: ADULT_SIGRID
entries.copy: I route. You anchor. Either may call retreat.

entries.speaker: NARRATION
entries.copy: The last keeper's tools had grown into Crownroot.

entries.speaker: ADULT_SOREN
entries.copy: I seat the tool only while you run.

entries.speaker: NARRATION
entries.copy: One burned. One went dark. One came closer.
